The rest act on the\nblock tree returned by `parse_lines` and on the exact stdout bytes, which is the state handed back.\nThe corpus section examples that use quotes, lists and indented code are gated in the tabs story\nand are not run here.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import HTML_BLOCK, Block, parse_lines\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef kinds(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Names of the top-level block types that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child.kind.name for child in parse_lines(lines).children]\n\n\ndef html_blocks(lines: list[str]) -> list[Block]:\n    \"\"\"The top-level HTML blocks that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child for child in parse_lines(lines).children if child.kind is HTML_BLOCK]\n\n\ndef html_contents(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The content of each top-level HTML block, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [block.content for block in html_blocks(lines)]\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-HTML-Blocks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_raw_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block-level tag block passes through verbatim and its Markdown is not parsed.\"\"\"\n    block = \"<div>\\n*foo*\\n</div>\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, block + \"\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert block in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_ends_at_blank_line(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A type 6 block ends at a blank line and Markdown after it is parsed.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"<div>\\nraw\\n\\n*bar*\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_comment_spans_blank_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A comment block keeps blank lines until its end marker, and the following line is a paragraph.\"\"\"\n    comment = \"<!-- Foo\\n\\nbar\\n   baz -->\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, comment + \"\\nokay\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert comment in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_pre_spans_blank_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A pre block keeps blank lines and does not parse the Markdown inside it.\"\"\"\n    block = \"<pre>\\n*x*\\n\\n_y_\\n</pre>\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, block + \"\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert block in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type7_cannot_interrupt(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A lone open tag line after paragraph text stays inside the paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, 'Foo\\n<a href=\"bar\">\\nbaz\\n')\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_interrupts_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block-level tag line interrupts a paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo\\n<div>\\nbar\\n</div>\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_four_space_indent_is_code(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Four spaces of indentation make an indented code block, not an HTML block.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"    <!-- foo -->\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<pre>\") == 1\n\n\n# --- Start conditions ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<pre>\", \"<PRE>\", \"<script>\", \"<Style>\", \"<textarea>\", \"<pre class=\\\"x\\\">\"])\ndef test_type1_start_matches_each_raw_text_tag(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Start condition 1 holds for pre, script, style and textarea in any case, and keeps blank lines.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\", \"\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"html_block\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_start_needs_a_space_tab_or_end_after_the_name() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<prefix` is not start condition 1, and it is not a complete tag either.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<prefix\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_end_need_not_match_the_start_tag() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A script block ends at a style end tag.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<script>\", \"a\", \"</style>\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"<script>\\na\\n</style>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type2_comment_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A comment block ends at the line that contains `-->`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<!--\", \"a\", \"b -->\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<!--\\na\\nb -->\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type2_start_needs_the_full_marker() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<!-x` is not a comment start.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<!-x\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type3_processing_instruction_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A processing instruction block ends at the line that contains `?>`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<?php\", \"a\", \"b ?>\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<?php\\na\\nb ?>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type4_declaration_ends_at_the_line_with_a_greater_than() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A declaration starts with `<!` and a letter, and its end line is the one with `>`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<!DOCTYPE\", \"html>\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<!DOCTYPE\\nhtml>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type4_needs_a_letter_after_the_bang() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<!1` is not a declaration start.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<!1x\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type5_cdata_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A CDATA block ends at the line that contains `]]>`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<![CDATA[\", \"a\", \"b ]]>\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<![CDATA[\\na\\nb ]]>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type5_needs_the_full_cdata_marker() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<![CDATA` without its closing bracket is not a CDATA start.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<![CDATA x\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<div>\", \"<DIV>\", \"<div/>\", \"<div class=\\\"x\\\">\", \"<div\\t>\", \"<p>\", \"</div>\"])\ndef test_type6_start_matches_block_tag_forms(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Start condition 6 holds for an open or closing block tag followed by a space, tab, `>` or `/>`.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\"]) == [\"html_block\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<divx\", \"<dix\", \"<pa\"])\ndef test_type6_start_needs_the_name_to_end_there(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block tag name followed by other letters is not start condition 6, and an incomplete tag is not type 7.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type6_ends_before_a_blank_line_and_the_blank_is_not_kept() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A type 6 block stops at the blank line, which is not part of its content.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<div>\", \"a\", \"\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"<div>\\na\\n\"]\n    assert kinds([\"<div>\", \"a\", \"\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"html_block\", \"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type6_blank_line_with_spaces_and_tabs_ends_the_block() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line of only spaces and tabs is a blank line for ending a type 6 block.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<div>\", \"  \\t \", \"*a*\"]) == [\"html_block\", \"paragraph\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"line\", ['<a href=\"bar\">', \"<a href='x' title=y data>\", \"<custom>  \", \"</a>\", \"<a/>\"])\ndef test_type7_start_matches_a_complete_tag_alone_on_its_line(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Start condition 7 holds for a complete open tag or closing tag, then spaces and tabs.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([line, \"*a*\"]) == [\"html_block\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"line\", ['<a href=\"x\"', \"<a> b\", \"<a></a>\", \"< a>\", \"<a b=>\"])\ndef test_type7_start_refuses_incomplete_or_trailing_content(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tag that is not complete, or is followed by other text, is not start condition 7.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([line, \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type7_start_refuses_a_pre_tag_name_with_a_different_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<pre>` is start condition 1, so its block keeps going past the blank line instead of ending there.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<pre>\", \"*a*\", \"\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"<pre>\\n*a*\\n\\n*b*\\n\"]\n\n\n# --- Interruption of a paragraph ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<pre>\", \"<!--\", \"<?php\", \"<!DOCTYPE html\", \"<![CDATA[\", \"<div>\"])\ndef test_types_1_to_6_interrupt_a_paragraph(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Types 1 to 6 close an open paragraph and start an HTML block.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", opener, \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\", \"html_block\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"line\", [\"<custom>\", \"</custom>\", '<a href=\"b\">'])\ndef test_type7_cannot_interrupt_a_paragraph(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A complete tag line after paragraph text stays in the paragraph.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", line, \"baz\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type7_starts_after_a_blank_line_ends_the_paragraph() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Once a blank line closes the paragraph, type 7 can start a block.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"\", \"<custom>\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\", \"html_block\"]\n\n\n# --- End conditions and single-line blocks ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"line\",\n    [\"<pre></pre>\", \"<!-- x -->\", \"<? x ?>\", \"<!x>\", \"<![CDATA[x]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_types_1_to_5_on_one_line_make_a_single_line_block(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When the [line + \"\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_types_1_to_5_end_line_keeps_text_after_the_end_tag() -> None:\n    \"\"\"The end line is part of the block, including anything after its end tag.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<pre>\", \"x</pre> tail\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"<pre>\\nx</pre> tail\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_block_runs_to_end_of_document_when_never_closed() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed type 1 block keeps every line to the end of the document, blank lines included.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<pre>\", \"a\", \"\", \"b\"]) == [\"<pre>\\na\\n\\nb\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type2_block_runs_to_end_of_document_when_never_closed() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed comment block keeps every line to the end of the document.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<!--\", test_lines_keep_their_original_indentation_and_are_not_parsed() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Indentation up to three spaces and inline Markdown are kept as written.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"   <div>\", \"  *a* & <b>\", \"</div>\"]) == [\"   <div>\\n  *a* & <b>\\n</div>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_tags_inside_a_block_do_not_change_its_state() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A comment start inside a type 6 block The rest act on the\nblock tree returned by `parse_lines` and on the exact stdout bytes, which is the state handed back.\nThe corpus section examples that use quotes, lists and indented code are gated in the tabs story\nand are not run here.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import HTML_BLOCK, Block, parse_lines\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef kinds(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Names of the top-level block types that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child.kind.name for child in parse_lines(lines).children]\n\n\ndef html_blocks(lines: list[str]) -> list[Block]:\n    \"\"\"The top-level HTML blocks that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child for child in parse_lines(lines).children if child.kind is HTML_BLOCK]\n\n\ndef html_contents(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The content of each top-level HTML block, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [block.content for block in html_blocks(lines)]\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-HTML-Blocks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_raw_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block-level tag block passes through verbatim and its Markdown is not parsed.\"\"\"\n    block = \"<div>\\n*foo*\\n</div>\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, block + \"\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert block in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_ends_at_blank_line(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A type 6 block ends at a blank line and Markdown after it is parsed.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"<div>\\nraw\\n\\n*bar*\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_comment_spans_blank_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A comment block keeps blank lines until its end marker, and the following line is a paragraph.\"\"\"\n    comment = \"<!-- Foo\\n\\nbar\\n   baz -->\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, comment + \"\\nokay\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert comment in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_pre_spans_blank_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A pre block keeps blank lines and does not parse the Markdown inside it.\"\"\"\n    block = \"<pre>\\n*x*\\n\\n_y_\\n</pre>\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, block + \"\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert block in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type7_cannot_interrupt(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A lone open tag line after paragraph text stays inside the paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, 'Foo\\n<a href=\"bar\">\\nbaz\\n')\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_interrupts_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block-level tag line interrupts a paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo\\n<div>\\nbar\\n</div>\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_four_space_indent_is_code(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Four spaces of indentation make an indented code block, not an HTML block.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"    <!-- foo -->\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<pre>\") == 1\n\n\n# --- Start conditions ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<pre>\", \"<PRE>\", \"<script>\", \"<Style>\", \"<textarea>\", \"<pre class=\\\"x\\\">\"])\ndef test_type1_start_matches_each_raw_text_tag(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Start condition 1 holds for pre, script, style and textarea in any case, and keeps blank lines.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\", \"\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"html_block\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_start_needs_a_space_tab_or_end_after_the_name() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<prefix` is not start condition 1, and it is not a complete tag either.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<prefix\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_end_need_not_match_the_start_tag() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A script block ends at a style end tag.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<script>\", \"a\", \"</style>\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"<script>\\na\\n</style>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type2_comment_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A comment block ends at the line that contains `-->`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<!--\", \"a\", \"b -->\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<!--\\na\\nb -->\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type2_start_needs_the_full_marker() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<!-x` is not a comment start.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<!-x\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type3_processing_instruction_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A processing instruction block ends at the line that contains `?>`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<?php\", \"a\", \"b ?>\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<?php\\na\\nb ?>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type4_declaration_ends_at_the_line_with_a_greater_than() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A declaration starts with `<!` and a letter, and its end line is the one with `>`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<!DOCTYPE\", \"html>\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<!DOCTYPE\\nhtml>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type4_needs_a_letter_after_the_bang() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<!1` is not a declaration start.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<!1x\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type5_cdata_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A CDATA block ends at the line that contains `]]>`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<![CDATA[\", \"a\", \"b ]]>\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<![CDATA[\\na\\nb ]]>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type5_needs_the_full_cdata_marker() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<![CDATA` without its closing bracket is not a CDATA start.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<![CDATA x\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<div>\", \"<DIV>\", \"<div/>\", \"<div class=\\\"x\\\">\", \"<div\\t>\", \"<p>\", \"</div>\"])\ndef test_type6_start_matches_block_tag_forms(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Start condition 6 holds for an open or closing block tag followed by a space, tab, `>` or `/>`.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\"]) == [\"html_block\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<divx\", \"<dix\", \"<pa\"])\ndef test_type6_start_needs_the_name_to_end_there(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block tag name followed by other letters is not start condition 6, and an incomplete tag is not type 7.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type6_ends_before_a_blank_line_and_the_blank_is_not_kept() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A type 6 block stops at the blank line, which is not \"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type6_blank_line_with_spaces_and_tabs_ends_the_block() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line of only spaces and tabs is a blank line for ending a type 6 block.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<div>\", \"  \\t \", \"*a*\"]) == [\"html_block\", \"paragraph\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"line\", ['<a href=\"bar\">', \"<a href='x' title=y data>\", \"<custom>  \", \"</a>\", \"<a/>\"])\ndef test_type7_start_matches_a_complete_tag_alone_on_its_line(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Start condition 7 holds for a complete open tag or closing tag, then spaces and tabs.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([line, \"*a*\"]) == [\"html_block\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"line\", ['<a href=\"x\"', \"<a> b\", \"<a></a>\", \"< a>\", \"<a b=>\"])\ndef test_type7_start_refuses_incomplete_or_trailing_content(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tag that is not complete, or is followed by other text, is not start condition 7.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([line, \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_pre_tag_is_type1_so_a_blank_line_does_not_end_it() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<pre>` is start condition 1, not 7, so its block keeps going past the [\"<pre>\", \"<!--\", \"<?php\", \"<!DOCTYPE html\", \"<![CDATA[\", \"<div>\"])\ndef test_types_1_to_6_interrupt_a_paragraph(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Types 1 to 6 close an open paragraph and start an HTML block.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", opener, \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\", \"html_block\"]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"line\", [\"<custom>\", \"</custom>\", '<a href=\"b\">'])\ndef test_type7_cannot_interrupt_a_paragraph(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A complete tag line after paragraph text stays in the paragraph.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", line, \"baz\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type7_starts_after_a_blank_line_ends_the_paragraph() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Once a blank line closes the paragraph, type 7 can start a block.\"\"\"\n    assert [\"<pre></pre>\", \"<!-- x -->\", \"<? x ?>\", \"<!x>\", \"<![CDATA[x]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_types_1_to_5_on_one_line_make_a_single_line_block(line: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When the first line meets both start and end conditions, the block is that line alone.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([line, \"*a*\"]) == [\"html_block\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert html_contents([line, \"*a*\"]) == [line + \"\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_types_1_to_5_end_line_keeps_text_after_the_end_tag() -> None:\n    \"\"\"The end line is part of the block, including anything after its end tag.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<pre>\", \"x</pre> tail\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"<pre>\\nx</pre> tail\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_block_runs_to_end_of_document_when_never_closed() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed type 1 {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VxaR3VYXaRnSgmgfVysdbt","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/blocks.py has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"95afe858-f390-4c96-a94b-00c653ec1549","uuid":"380f4917-02bc-4aae-be71-f5b106344f18","timestamp":"2026-10-14T07:39:19.356Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/blocks.py","oldString":"# A complete open tag or closing tag, with its name captured, as the raw HTML grammar defines it.\nCOMPLETE_OPEN_TAG = re.compile(rf\"<({HTML_TAG_NAME})(?:{HTML_ATTRIBUTE})*[ \\t]*/?>\")\nCOMPLETE_CLOSE_TAG = re.compile(rf\"</({HTML_TAG_NAME})[ \\t]*>\")","newString":"# A complete open tag or closing tag, with its name captured, as the raw HTML grammar defines it. Only\n# spaces and tabs may follow it on the line.\nCOMPLETE_OPEN_TAG = re.compile(rf\"<({HTML_TAG_NAME})(?:{HTML_ATTRIBUTE})*[ \\t]*/?>[ \\t]*\")\nCOMPLETE_CLOSE_TAG = re.compile(rf\"</({HTML_TAG_NAME})[ \\t]*>[ \\t]*\")","originalFile":"\"\"\"Phase 1: block tree, block-type registry, per-line procedure, and lazy continuation.\n\nResponsibility: consume lines one at a time, match them against open blocks, look for new block\nstarts, and add remaining text to the deepest open block. Link reference definitions are handed to\n`mdparser.refs` when a paragraph closes.\n\nEach block type is a `BlockType` record registered in a `BlockRegistry`. A type supplies a start\nrule, a continue rule and a close (finalize) rule; the per-line loop in `DocumentParser` never\nnames a concrete type.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom mdparser.entities import unescape_and_decode\nfrom mdparser.refs import ReferenceMap, extract_definitions\n\nTAB_STOP = 4\nSPACE_CHARS = \" \\t\"\n\n# A start rule inspects the rest of the line below `container`. It returns a new block, after\n# advancing the cursor past its marker, or None, leaving the cursor untouched.\nStartRule = Callable[[\"Cursor\", \"Block\"], \"Block | None\"]\n# A continue rule decides whether the line continues an open block. It advances the cursor only\n# when it returns True.\nContinueRule = Callable[[\"Block\", \"Cursor\"], bool]\n# An add-line rule appends the remaining line text to a leaf block that accepts lines.\nAddLineRule = Callable[[\"Block\", \"Cursor\"], None]\n# A finalize rule runs once when a block closes, for example to set its content.\nFinalizeRule = Callable[[\"Block\"], None]\n\n\ndef next_column(char: str, col: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the column after `char`, which sits at column `col`. Tabs advance to the next tab stop.\"\"\"\n    if char == \"\\t\":\n        return col + TAB_STOP - col % TAB_STOP\n    return col + 1\n\n\ndef indent_columns(line: str, pos: int, col: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the width in columns of the spaces and tabs starting at `pos`, which sits at `col`.\"\"\"\n    end = pos\n    end_col = col\n    while end < len(line) and line[end] in SPACE_CHARS:\n        end_col = next_column(line[end], end_col)\n        end += 1\n    return end_col - col\n\n\nclass Cursor:\n    \"\"\"A position in one source line, tracked both as a character index and as a column.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, line: str) -> None:\n        self.line = line\n        self.pos = 0\n        self.col = 0\n\n    @property\n    def rest(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The text from the current position to the end of the line.\"\"\"\n        return self.line[self.pos :]\n\n    @property\n    def indent(self) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Columns of indentation from the current position to the next non-space character.\"\"\"\n        return indent_columns(self.line, self.pos, self.col)\n\n    def next_nonspace(self) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Index of the first character at or after the current position that is not a space or tab.\"\"\"\n        end = self.pos\n        while end < len(self.line) and self.line[end] in SPACE_CHARS:\n            end += 1\n        return end\n\n    def is_blank(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"True when only spaces and tabs remain on the line.\"\"\"\n        return self.next_nonspace() == len(self.line)\n\n    def advance_to(self, index: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Move the cursor forward to character `index`, tracking the column.\"\"\"\n        while self.pos < index:\n            self.col = next_column(self.line[self.pos], self.col)\n            self.pos += 1\n\n    def advance_nonspace(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Skip spaces and tabs up to the next non-space character.\"\"\"\n        self.advance_to(self.next_nonspace())\n\n    def advance_columns(self, columns: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Consume spaces and tabs until `columns` columns are passed.\n\n        A tab that straddles the target column is consumed whole, so the column may overshoot.\n        \"\"\"\n        target = self.col + columns\n        while self.pos < len(self.line) and self.col < target and self.line[self.pos] in SPACE_CHARS:\n            self.col = next_column(self.line[self.pos], self.col)\n            self.pos += 1\n\n\nclass Block:\n    \"\"\"A node in the block tree. Leaf blocks keep their raw lines; `content` is set when they close.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, kind: BlockType) -> None:\n        self.kind = kind\n        self.parent: Block | None = None\n        self.children: list[Block] = []\n        self.is_open = True\n        self.lines: list[str] = []\n        self.content = \"\"\n        # Heading level, 1 to 6, for an ATX heading. Zero for every other block.\n        self.level = 0\n        # The document-wide reference map. Only the document root holds one.\n        self.references: ReferenceMap | None = None\n        # The opening fence and its state, for a fenced code block. None for every other block.\n        self.fence: Fence | None = None\n        # The start condition and end state of an HTML block. None for every other block.\n        self.html: HtmlState | None = None\n\n    def open_last_child(self) -> Block | None:\n        \"\"\"The last child if it is still open, otherwise None.\"\"\"\n        if self.children and self.children[-1].is_open:\n            return self.children[-1]\n        return None\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass BlockType:\n    \"\"\"The rules that define one kind of block.\n\n    `accepts_lines` marks a leaf that takes line text. `interruptible` lets a start rule close such\n    a leaf (a paragraph); a non-interruptible leaf blocks new starts. `lazy` lets a non-matching\n    line join this block as a lazy continuation. `is_container` lets the block hold child blocks.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    name: str\n    continues: ContinueRule\n    is_container: bool = False\n    accepts_lines: bool = False\n    interruptible: bool = False\n    lazy: bool = False\n    start: StartRule | None = None\n    add_line: AddLineRule | None = None\n    finalize: FinalizeRule | None = None\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if self.accepts_lines and self.add_line is None:\n            raise ValueError(f\"block type {self.name!r} accepts lines but has no add_line rule\")\n        if self.lazy and not self.accepts_lines:\n            raise ValueError(f\"block type {self.name!r} is lazy but does not accept lines\")\n\n\ndef _always_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    return True\n\n\ndef _paragraph_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    return not cursor.is_blank()\n\n\ndef _paragraph_add_line(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> None:\n    cursor.advance_nonspace()\n    block.lines.append(cursor.rest)\n\n\ndef _paragraph_finalize(block: Block) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Move leading link reference definitions into the document map and keep the remaining text.\n\n    A paragraph that holds only definitions leaves the tree.\n    \"\"\"\n    text = \"\\n\".join(block.lines).strip(\" \\t\")\n    block.content = extract_definitions(text, _document_references(block))\n    if not block.content and block.parent is not None:\n        block.parent.children.remove(block)\n\n\ndef _document_references(block: Block) -> ReferenceMap:\n    \"\"\"The reference map of the document root that `block` belongs to.\"\"\"\n    root = block\n    while root.parent is not None:\n        root = root.parent\n    assert root.references is not None\n    return root.references\n\n\ndef _never_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    return False\n\n\nTHEMATIC_BREAK_MARKERS = \"*-_\"\nTHEMATIC_BREAK_MIN_MARKERS = 3\n\n\ndef _thematic_break_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    \"\"\"Start a thematic break when the rest of the line is three or more matching marker characters.\n\n    Spaces and tabs may appear between and after the markers. Any other character, or four or more\n    columns of indentation, means the line is not a thematic break.\n    \"\"\"\n    if cursor.indent >= 4:\n        return None\n    start = cursor.next_nonspace()\n    line = cursor.line\n    if start == len(line) or line[start] not in THEMATIC_BREAK_MARKERS:\n        return None\n    marker = line[start]\n    count = 0\n    for char in line[start:]:\n        if char == marker:\n            count += 1\n        elif char not in SPACE_CHARS:\n            return None\n    if count < THEMATIC_BREAK_MIN_MARKERS:\n        return None\n    cursor.advance_to(len(line))\n    return Block(THEMATIC_BREAK)\n\n\nATX_MARKER = \"#\"\nATX_MAX_LEVEL = 6\n\n\ndef _atx_heading_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    \"\"\"Start an ATX heading when the line opens with one to six `#` characters.\n\n    The opening run must be followed by a space, a tab or the end of the line. The content is the\n    rest of the line, stripped of surrounding spaces and tabs, without a closing sequence.\n    \"\"\"\n    if cursor.indent >= 4:\n        return None\n    line = cursor.line\n    start = cursor.next_nonspace()\n    end = start\n    while end < len(line) and line[end] == ATX_MARKER:\n        end += 1\n    level = end - start\n    if not 1 <= level <= ATX_MAX_LEVEL:\n        return None\n    if end < len(line) and line[end] not in SPACE_CHARS:\n        return None\n    cursor.advance_to(len(line))\n    heading = Block(ATX_HEADING)\n    heading.level = level\n    heading.content = _strip_closing_sequence(line[end:].strip(SPACE_CHARS))\n    return heading\n\n\ndef _strip_closing_sequence(content: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Remove a closing run of `#` characters from the end of heading content.\n\n    The run must be the whole content or follow a space or tab. So `foo#` keeps its hash, and so\n    does `foo \\\\#`, where the backslash is not whitespace.\n    \"\"\"\n    stripped = content.rstrip(ATX_MARKER)\n    if stripped == content:\n        return content\n    if stripped == \"\" or stripped[-1] in SPACE_CHARS:\n        return stripped.rstrip(SPACE_CHARS)\n    return content\n\n\nDOCUMENT = BlockType(\"document\", continues=_always_continues, is_container=True)\nPARAGRAPH = BlockType(\n    \"paragraph\",\n    continues=_paragraph_continues,\n    accepts_lines=True,\n    interruptible=True,\n    lazy=True,\n    add_line=_paragraph_add_line,\n    finalize=_paragraph_finalize,\n)\n# A thematic break is a complete single-line block. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"95afe858-f390-4c96-a94b-00c653ec1549","uuid":"d1b581d3-4c03-49e5-8ca7-f61cfd8840f7","timestamp":"2026-10-14T07:39:20.281Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/tests/test_html_blocks.py","oldString":"    \"\"\"Raw HTML is not percent-encoded or escaped, so non-ASCII text passes through.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"<span>é</span>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout == \"<span>é</span>\\n\"","newString":"    \"\"\"Raw HTML is not percent-encoded or escaped, so non-ASCII text passes through.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"<div>é</div>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout == \"<div>é</div>\\n\"","originalFile":"\"\"\"HTML block tests: the seven declared checks from FEATURE-HTML-Blocks.md, then block-tree and\nexact-output tests through the `commonmark` executable.\n\nThe declared checks are transcribed first, with their assertions unchanged. The rest act on the\nblock tree returned by `parse_lines` and on the exact stdout bytes, which is the state handed back.\nThe corpus section examples that use quotes, lists and indented code are gated in the tabs story\nand are not run here.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import HTML_BLOCK, Block, parse_lines\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef kinds(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Names of the top-level block types that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child.kind.name for child in parse_lines(lines).children]\n\n\ndef html_blocks(lines: list[str]) -> list[Block]:\n    \"\"\"The top-level HTML blocks that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child for child in parse_lines(lines).children if child.kind is HTML_BLOCK]\n\n\ndef html_contents(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The content of each top-level HTML block, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [block.content for block in html_blocks(lines)]\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-HTML-Blocks.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_raw_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block-level tag block passes through verbatim and its Markdown is not parsed.\"\"\"\n    block = \"<div>\\n*foo*\\n</div>\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, block + \"\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert block in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_ends_at_blank_line(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A type 6 block ends at a blank line and Markdown after it is parsed.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"<div>\\nraw\\n\\n*bar*\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_comment_spans_blank_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A comment block keeps blank lines until its end marker, and the following line is a paragraph.\"\"\"\n    comment = \"<!-- Foo\\n\\nbar\\n   baz -->\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, comment + \"\\nokay\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert comment in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_pre_spans_blank_lines(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A pre block keeps blank lines and does not parse the Markdown inside it.\"\"\"\n    block = \"<pre>\\n*x*\\n\\n_y_\\n</pre>\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, block + \"\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert block in result.stdout\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type7_cannot_interrupt(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A lone open tag line after paragraph text stays inside the paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, 'Foo\\n<a href=\"bar\">\\nbaz\\n')\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_type6_interrupts_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A block-level tag line interrupts a paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo\\n<div>\\nbar\\n</div>\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_htmlblock_four_space_indent_is_code(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Four spaces of indentation make an indented code block, not an HTML block.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"    <!-- foo -->\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<pre>\") == 1\n\n\n# --- Start conditions ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"opener\", [\"<pre>\", \"<PRE>\", \"<script>\", \"<Style>\", \"<textarea>\", \"<pre class=\\\"x\\\">\"])\ndef test_type1_start_matches_each_raw_text_tag(opener: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Start condition 1 holds for pre, script, style and textarea in any case, and keeps blank lines.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\", \"\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"html_block\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_start_needs_a_space_tab_or_end_after_the_name() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<prefix` is not start condition 1, and it is not a complete tag either.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<prefix\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type1_end_need_not_match_the_start_tag() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A script block ends at a style end tag.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<script>\", \"a\", \"</style>\", \"*b*\"]) == [\"<script>\\na\\n</style>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type2_comment_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A comment block ends at the line that contains `-->`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<!--\", \"a\", \"b -->\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<!--\\na\\nb -->\\n\"]\n\n\ndef test_type2_start_needs_the_full_marker() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`<!-x` is not a comment start.\"\"\"\n    assert kinds([\"<!-x\", \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type3_processing_instruction_start_and_end() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A processing instruction block ends at the line that contains `?>`.\"\"\"\n    assert html_contents([\"<?php\", \"a\", \"b ?>\", \"*c*\"]) == [\"<?php\\na\\nb ?>\\n\"]\n\n\ndef assert kinds([opener, \"*a*\"]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_type6_ends_before_a_blank_line_and_the_blank_is_not_kept() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A type 6 block stops at the blank line, which is not {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1kbx8vtFTDWYtk2zd8b","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"HTML block parsing is implemented, and the full project test suite passes. The conformance runner (`sources/spec_tests.py`) was not run, because no acceptance criterion in this step invokes it. The spec gates the corpus examples in the later cont-tabs-slice story.\n\n**What changed**\n- `mdparser/blocks.py`: the seven HTML block start and end conditions, the type 6 tag list, and the type 7 complete-tag grammar. Types 1 to 5 close on their end line, and types 6 and 7 close before a blank line. Type 7 is refused while a paragraph is open.
